# Shri Ram Graphics
> Imagine • Believe • Create

Shri Ram Graphics is a premier packaging box manufacturer and commercial offset printing press based in New Delhi, India.

## Business Profile
- **Company Name**: Shri Ram Graphics (SRG Packaging)
- **Tagline**: Imagine • Believe • Create

## Products & Capabilities
1. **Duplex Boxes & Mono-Cartons (HSN 48192020)**
   - Custom folding cartons for Orthopedic & Healthcare products (Wrist Binder boxes, Knee supports, Cervical collars, Lumbar braces, Traction kits).
   - 300 to 450 GSM White Duplex Board, Cyber XL, and FBB.
   - Reverse-tuck, straight-tuck, and auto crash-lock bottom structures.

2. **Corrugated Boxes & Master Shipping Cartons**
   - 3-Ply single-wall corrugated boxes for transit packaging.
   - 5-Ply double-wall heavy-duty master cartons (18 - 32 BF) for bulk storage and logistics.

3. **Quality Offset Printing Works & Embellishments**
   - Multi-color CMYK and Pantone sheetfed commercial offset printing up to 28 x 40 inch format.
   - Thermal BOPP Lamination (Matte & Gloss).
   - Spot UV gloss coating and drip-off varnish.
   - Metallic Hot Foil Stamping (Gold/Silver).
   - 3D Embossing, Debossing, and Braille.
   - Automatic platen die-punching and crack-free creasing.
